items.summary: Code injection (CWE-94) in Dassault Systèmes' GEOVIA Geospatial Data Manager (3DEXPERIENCE releases R2024x through R2026x) lets an attacker execute arbitrary code on the server, risking unauthorized access and data loss.

Deserialization of untrusted data in Apache Roller 6.1.5's XML-RPC endpoint (fixed in 6.1.6) allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to achieve arbitrary code execution; the endpoint parses requests even when XML-RPC is disabled in configuration.

Buffer overflow in an interface of HPE Networking Instant ON lets an unauthenticated remote attacker run arbitrary code as a privileged user on the underlying host; disclosed under HPE advisory hpesbnw05150en_us.
Use-after-free (CWE-416) in Firefox's Widget: Gtk component enabling a sandbox escape; fixed in Firefox 157, Firefox ESR 153.4, and Firefox ESR 140.17.

Incorrect authorization in Apache Roller 6.1.5's OAuth 1.0a endpoint lets an unauthenticated attacker holding an outstanding request token for a site-wide consumer obtain an access token for any user without the normal approval step.
